versions.changelog:
ai-grader 2.7.1

- Major documentation refresh: updated and expanded SKILL.md and README.md
- Replaced or removed old files for a more streamlined package (e.g. removed manifest.json, skill-card.md)
- Added reference and metadata files: AGENTS.md, llms.txt
- Improved external evaluation flow via updated external_judge_prompt_trial.txt and probe pack files
- Minor code and HTML updates for grading/report visuals
- Updated licensing and compliance references

- Improved evaluation trigger rules in SKILL.md to clarify when the skill activates, preventing unintended activation in casual conversation.
- Updated exclusions in SKILL.md to explicitly prevent use for human personality/behavior analysis and ordinary chat quality discussions.
- Changed ambassador field in SKILL.md from 诺衡 to Krites.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file.
- Added compiled Python cache file __pycache__/grade_stats.cpython-313.pyc.

ai-grader 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides a universal scoring framework to assess AI reliability and behavior using the 45-item awareness scale.
- Supports evaluation of any AI (ChatGPT, Claude, custom Agents) for reliability, stability, and comparative analysis.
- Offers multilingual support: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Arabic.
- Includes governance and compliance grounding (AI Passport Regime, A³ Laws, ISO/IEC 42001 alignment).
- MIT license; agent-ready and discoverable by AI.
